prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 4:5 high-contrast black-and-white cinematic portrait of a stylish adult man matching the required approved adult non-public-figure identity reference. He has a sharp goatee, natural skin texture, and a composed authoritative expression. He wears a perfectly tailored black suit with a white shirt, dark tie, and sleek black Chelsea boots, leaning confidently against a matte-black luxury SUV with a relaxed yet commanding posture. Place two distinct adult bodyguards in dark tailored suits symmetrically behind him, with a grand mansion and elegant white pillars beneath a clear sky in the background. Use crisp professional daylight, controlled contrast, clean highlights, balanced silhouettes, a 50mm lens, realistic textures, and no readable license text, logos, or branding.
